name: Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width holding a kettlebell in each hand at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips, then drive them forward to bring one bell up close to your torso.
Slip your hand through the handle and receive the bell against your forearm at shoulder height.
Lower the racked kettlebell smoothly back down into the hang while cleaning the opposite kettlebell up to its shoulder.
Continue alternating arms in a crisp, rhythmic cadence while keeping your core braced.
tips: Keep the rising kettlebell close to your body and punch your hand smoothly around the handle so it lands softly on your forearm.
Drive each clean with hip extension rather than curling the kettlebell up with your biceps.
